column3: Close to the Hebrew; “I rejoiced in those who said” is rendered “I was glad when they said.”
Close to the Hebrew; “joined together to itself” is rendered “compact together.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “the Testimony of Israel” and supplies “To.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִשְׁלָיוּ (“be secure”) is rendered “May they prosper.”
